intent: Route-target container (standalone OnPush) injecting only DashboardStore. On init calls DashboardStore.load() then DashboardStore.startLive(); on destroy DashboardStore.stopLive(). Template renders by DashboardStore.state (loading/empty/error with retry via load()/success) composing BiometricTilesComponent[metric], ComparisonBarsComponent[ratios], RadialGaugesComponent[gauges], ChevronStepperComponent[phases], ExerciseStepCardsComponent[steps], StatisticsBarComponent[intensity] in the dashboard grid areas (tiles,bars,gauges,timeline,steps,stats), and a reset button calling DashboardStore.resetRatios(). Consumes DashboardStore.state: Signal<ViewState>; DashboardStore.metric: Signal<BiometricMetric | null>; DashboardStore.ratios: Signal<TrainingRatio[]>; DashboardStore.steps: Signal<WorkoutStep[]>; DashboardStore.phases: Signal<PhaseProgress[]>; DashboardStore.gauges: Signal<GaugeValue[]>; DashboardStore.intensity: Signal<number>; DashboardStore.load(): void; DashboardStore.startLive(): void; DashboardStore.stopLive(): void; DashboardStore.resetRatios(): void.
